'''Daruo''' is a member of the [[Seanchan]] [[Deathwatch Guard]].

== History ==
Daruo has caught an arrow mid-flight with his bare hand.

== Activities ==
Daruo is on duty, when [[Matrim Cauthon]] saves [[Fortuona Athaem Devi Paendrag]]'s life from a [[Gray Man]]. He is sent to search for the Gray Man, who managed to escape in the confusion.

==Trivia==
*Daruo is named after Jay Dauro, a fan of ''The Wheel of Time''.<ref name="thirteenth-depository">Taglieri, Linda. [http://13depository.blogspot.com/2002/02/character-names-derived-from-readers.html Character Names Derived From Readers' Names]</ref>
